d: Jharkhand men naksalvad ko hamesha ke lie khatm karne ki taiyari ab ek nae star par pahunch gaee hai. janglon men muthbher, giraphtari aur hathiyaron ki baramadgi ke bad pulis ne ab naksaliyon ke khilaph adalat men nirnayak laraee larne ki ranniti banaee hai. varshon tak khun bahane, puliskarmiyon ki hatya karne, graminon men dahshat phailane aur levi vasulkar aatank kayam karne vale hardakor naksaliyon ko ab kanuni rup se saja dilane ki taiyari hai.
